nodes.label: Test Driven Implementation Workflow
nodes.rationale: Each implementation task introduces a failing focused test before the corresponding application code and verification step.

nodes.label: No External Message Broker
nodes.rationale: The first release intentionally uses PostgreSQL and its sync_jobs table instead of Redis, Celery, or an external message broker.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Stateful Dependency
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL is the sole stateful dependency and persists durable jobs, idempotency records, mappings, polling cursors, and readiness state.
